findings: Three evidence snippets are not exact excerpts from the acquired source text: the peel dimensions/weight quote and both oven dimensions and weight/stone-thickness quotes concatenate fields separated by line breaks and intervening HTML text. The numerical claims are supported, but each snippet must be replaced with a clean contiguous excerpt of at least 12 characters and an accurate locator. All other selected evidence quotes were verified verbatim.

The selected plan otherwise has sufficient factual support to attempt construction: it preserves the official 170 × 800 × 20 mm, 0.4 kg peel specification; 630 × 580 × 370 mm oven exterior, 16-inch capacity, and 15 mm cordierite stone; correctly treats the 300 mm pizza, mouth/roof geometry, contact parameters, and rim compliance as provisional modeling choices; and documents the under-edge insertion, rotation, stone-contact, release, and withdrawal mechanism. The earlier short-quote failure is fixed, and novelty is appropriately deferred.
